entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed. It's not working at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number please?

Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF77812. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was so excited for this. Now it just won't sync with my app or my bike computer. I think it might be defective.

Okay, Sarah, thank you. I have your order pulled up here. I see you received the VeloBand about a month ago. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with how it functions?

It's a fault. I've tried everything. I charged it, I reinstalled the app... it's just broken. It won't connect no matter what I do. I really needed this money for some other bills, and I just feel like I wasted it.
I understand your frustration, and I want to get this sorted out for you. Let me just quickly review our policy for a defective item... one moment.

Alright, I've checked for you. It looks like you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. Since you're saying the item is broken, we can definitely cannot offer a refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure? Thank you so much. I was so worried.

Of course. Happy to help. I've just initiated the return on my end. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Wow, okay. That's fantastic. Thank you again, David. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
